breaches.title: Berlin Refuses to Pay Hackers Who Stole Data From the City's State Network
breaches.tldr: Berlin's state network was breached, leading to data theft. The city has refused to pay the hackers, confirming a significant data compromise incident affecting government systems.
breaches.action: Conduct a comprehensive forensic investigation to identify the breach's root cause and scope of data exfiltration. Strengthen network segmentation, access controls, and implement advanced threat detection.

breaches.title: 19 Chrome and Edge Extensions Found With Wallet-Stealing and Crypto-Draining Code
breaches.tldr: Nineteen malicious Chrome and Edge extensions were found deploying wallet-stealing and crypto-draining code. Users with these extensions are at high risk of financial asset theft and compromise of sensitive browser data.
breaches.action: Conduct an organization-wide audit of browser extensions on all endpoints. Enforce browser policies to restrict unauthorized extension installations. Advise users to immediately remove suspicious extensions and secure crypto wallets.

breaches.title: FulcrumSec claims Manchester Airports hack, theft of 86 GB of data
breaches.tldr: The hacking group FulcrumSec claims to have breached Manchester Airports Group and exfiltrated 86 GB of data. BleepingComputer has validated some stolen records, indicating a significant data breach affecting customer and booking information.
breaches.action: Implement enhanced data loss prevention (DLP) measures and egress filtering. Review third-party access and conduct an audit of databases holding sensitive customer information.

breaches.title: McKesson discloses breach after ShinyHunters claims patient data theft
breaches.tldr: McKesson, a major healthcare and pharmaceutical distributor, confirmed a cybersecurity incident leading to unauthorized access and data theft. The ShinyHunters extortion group claims to have stolen 284 million patient records, indicating a massive healthcare data compromise.
breaches.action: Prioritize supply chain security assessments for all third-party vendors. Implement strong encryption for patient data at rest and in transit. Enhance monitoring for unusual access patterns to critical applications.

ransomware.title: ATF Confirms Cyber Incident After Ransomware Group Claims Attack
ransomware.tldr: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) has confirmed a cyber incident following a ransomware group's claim of attack. This indicates a potential data encryption and/or exfiltration event affecting a federal agency.
ransomware.action: Immediately review and validate current incident response plans, focusing on ransomware recovery procedures. Ensure immutable backups are in place and test restoration processes. Implement robust endpoint detection and response (EDR) across all systems.

vulns.action: Apply the emergency patch for PaperCut NG and MF immediately. Conduct a thorough forensic analysis of PaperCut servers for signs of compromise, as active exploitation of a zero-day is confirmed.
